annotations.title: Read planning input choices and occupation categories

description: Read the Forms input choices, including the existing coarse occupation categories. Copy category IDs unchanged; trade includes technicians and is not a detailed industry taxonomy. This catalogue lookup does not require a dossier, save facts or run a calculation. Requires the authenticated One U Education account and declared planning scope; credentials and user identity are never tool arguments.
name: get_planning_input_options
